rationale: Price has surged from the session low of $11.42 to $12.27, now sitting at 94.4% of today's range and within $0.05 of the intraday high, with the last candle showing a wide spread and elevated volume — this is a late-stage momentum move with unfavorable risk/reward for a long entry. A short against the high is tempting given the extended position in range, but the strong upward momentum (five consecutive bullish 1-minute candles, price well above VWAP at $11.80 and 9-EMA at $11.77) and positive market backdrop (SPY +0.73%, VIXY -3.15%) make a fade risky. The wide bid-ask spread of ~49 bps on a $12 stock adds friction that erodes any edge in either direction.
